evaluation: Your draft cites Haugen and Rao [5] only in Section 2.2, where it adopts their sampling and dry-combustion protocol "exactly" and justifies this by saying your numbers can be compared directly with theirs. The retraction may or may not concern the protocol itself, so check the reason before deciding whether to keep, justify or replace the method and the comparison claim.
recommendation: Pause and discuss with your co-authors or supervisor, because your Section 2.2 method and comparison both rest on a paper that is now marked retracted with no stated reason. Find out why it was retracted, then keep and independently justify, or replace, the protocol, and remove the direct-comparison claim.
